hero_desc: The premier destination for exotic beetle enthusiasts. Professionally bred, health-guaranteed, and shipped safely across Thailand.
name: Name
health_guarantee_desc: If a beetle dies in transit, we replace or refund it. Film the unboxing and tell us within 2 hours.
express_shipping_desc: Live beetles ship Monday to Wednesday, never sitting in a depot over a weekend.
expert_bred_desc: Professional breeding stock sourced from top collectors.
understanding_beetle: Understanding your beetle is the key to successful keeping. Here's what every enthusiast should know.
metamorphosis_desc: Silver Thief Bugs undergo complete metamorphosis: egg → larva → pupa → adult. The larval stage can last 1–3 years depending on temperature and nutrition.
global_diversity_desc: With over 400,000 known species, beetles are the most diverse order of animals on Earth, representing about 25% of all known life forms.
diet_habitat_desc: Our beetles thrive on fermented oak flakes, beetle jelly, and rotting wood substrate. Proper humidity (70–80%) and temperature (25–28°C) are key to their health.
trophy_horns_desc: Male Silver Thief Bugs grow impressive horns used for fighting rivals during mating season. The largest specimens can reach 8 cm in horn length.
community_desc: Stay updated on new arrivals, live sales, and beetle care tips.
ready_to_start_desc: Browse our curated selection of premium exotic beetles, from rare rhinoceros beetles to stunning stag beetles.
footer_desc: The premium destination for exotic beetle enthusiasts. Quality breeding and rare specimens from around the world.

shipping_page.description: What shipping costs, when live beetles ship, and what the shop does if a beetle dies on the way.
shipping_page.fee_free: Free on every order, anywhere in Thailand.
shipping_page.fee_amount: {{amount}} per order, one rate anywhere in Thailand.
shipping_page.fee_unknown: The Shipping Fee is shown at checkout before you pay. We ship anywhere in Thailand.
when: We ship within 1–3 working days of receiving payment.
Live beetles ship Monday to Wednesday only, so no parcel waits in a depot over a weekend.
Food, logs/substrate and gear ship on any working day.
Live beetles go by Kerry or Flash.
In extreme heat or heavy rain we may postpone a shipment for the beetle's safety, and we always tell you first.
Once shipped, your tracking number is under "My orders".
shipping_page.guarantee_intro: If a beetle dies in transit, we send a replacement of the same species and pay its postage. If none is in stock, we refund the beetle's price in full.
claim: Film one continuous video from before you open the box until the beetle is clearly visible, with no cuts.
Tell us within 2 hours of receiving the parcel, with the video and your order number, through any channel on the Contact page.
not_covered: A parcel delayed or returned because no one was there to receive it, or it was collected late.
A wrong address or phone number entered at checkout.
No unboxing video, a video with cuts, or a report after 2 hours.
A beetle that dies after unboxing; the guarantee covers transit only.
refund: Before paying, you can cancel the order yourself on its order page; the reserved items go back on sale.
Paid but not yet shipped: contact us to cancel and we refund in full.
Refunds go back to the card or PromptPay you paid with, through Stripe.
Live beetles are not returnable or refundable for a change of mind.
Unopened gear in its original packaging can be returned within 7 days of delivery; you pay return postage and we refund once it reaches us.
Food and logs/substrate can't be returned, as they spoil and for hygiene.
If anything arrives damaged or wrong, we replace or refund it and cover every cost.

faq_page.description: Answers about ordering, shipping and your account. Can't find yours? Message the shop.

items.a: Credit/debit card or PromptPay. You pay on Stripe's secure page and come back to the shop; we never see your card details.

items.q: Can someone else buy a beetle that's in my cart?
items.a: Yes. Your cart doesn't reserve stock, and many beetles are one of a kind. We reserve items only when you press "Continue to payment".

items.q: How long are items reserved for me?
items.a: At least 30 minutes after you continue to payment; the payment page shows the time left. If it runs out before you pay, the order is cancelled automatically and the items go back on sale.

items.q: Do I need an account to order?
items.a: Yes, so you can follow your order's status and tracking number later.
Before paying, cancel it yourself on the order's page. After paying, contact the shop.
Live beetles ship only on certain weekdays, so no parcel waits in a depot over a weekend.

items.q: What if my beetle dies on the way?
items.a: We guarantee live arrival. Always film the unboxing and tell us quickly.
It depends on the product: live beetles, gear, and food or logs each have their own rule.

items.q: Why do I need to sign in to save favorites?
items.a: Favorites are kept with your account, so they follow you to any device.
On the sign-in page, press "Forgot password?" and enter your email; we'll send a link to set a new one.

items.q: My beetle has arrived. What first?
items.a: Film the unboxing, check that it moves, then move it into a prepared enclosure with moist substrate somewhere shaded and quiet. Let it rest a day before handling.
Adults eat beetle jelly; larvae eat fermented oak flakes and rotting wood. Change the jelly every 2–3 days.
About 25–28°C and 70–80% humidity. Don't let the substrate dry out or get waterlogged.

sections.title: Data controller
text: [Seller name], 1 Lam Narai, Chai Badan, Lopburi 15130, Thailand. Contact us about personal data at silverthiefbug.official@gmail.com.

sections.title: What we keep

The shipping addresses you save, and a copy of the address on each order.
Your order history, payment status and tracking numbers.
text: We never see or store your card details; payment data stays with Stripe.

LINE: a message to the shop owner for each paid order, with the order number, items, total and shipping address.
Carriers: the recipient's name, phone and address, to deliver the parcel.
Google Maps: the map on the About and Contact pages loads from Google.

sections.title: How long we keep it
text: Order history is kept for 5 years for accounting and tax. Everything else in your account is deleted when you ask.

sections.title: Your rights
text: Under Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019), you can ask to see, copy, correct or delete your data, or object to its use, by emailing silverthiefbug.official@gmail.com. We reply within 30 days.
